name: Turtle night and release
nameVi: Xem rùa biển đẻ trứng và thả rùa con
summary: A booked group watches a nesting turtle at night or releases hatchlings in the morning, after a briefing. The August 2025 park notice names Bảy Cạnh, Bãi Dương, Hòn Cau, Hòn Tài, Hòn Tre Lớn, and Bãi Đất Thắm. Night is 18:00–06:00, cap 50 at one site, at most five groups of about 10. Release is 05:30–07:30, turns 06:45–07:00 and 07:15–07:30, morning cap 100 at one moment. Nesting months were not printed.
when: Night 18:00–06:00. Release 05:30–07:30 when there are hatchlings. Nesting months: check on arrival.
